- So `tmp2` is derived from `file.getParentFile()`, which depends on the value of `name`
- `name` depends on `zipEntry.getName()` through the chain of function calls at line 11
- Therefore, `tmp2` indirectly depends on `zipEntry.getName()` because `tmp2` is derived from `file`, which is derived from `name`, which is derived from `zipEntry.getName()`
